records.query: Need blood culture results and echocardiography findings to assess for LVAD-related infection, along with complement levels and renal biopsy histopathology to characterize the glomerulonephritis pattern, as these are core to confirming or excluding the leading hypothesis of LVAD infection causing GN.
records.text:
- Blood cultures: positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium
- Low serum complement C3 concentrations
- Light Microscopy: 23 glomeruli examined: 6 globally sclerotic, 10 segmentally sclerotic, cellular, and filling Bowman's space circumferentially. Non-sclerotic glomerular segments showed increased mesangial matrix and mesangial cells. 80% of the cortex and outer medulla had chronic tubulointerstitial damage.
- Immunohistology: Positive mesangial staining for IgM, C1q, and C3. Negative for IgA and IgG. Some glomerular basement membranes stained for C3 without humps.
- Electron Microscopy: Mesangial regions with increased matrix and segmental subendothelial and mesangial osmiophilic deposits

bindings.label: Patient was admitted for evaluation of low-grade fever
A 55-year-old man had severe dilated cardiomyopathy and a left ventricular assist device (HeartMate II) implanted four years previously
Serum creatinine increased from 124 μmol/L to 354 μmol/L over two months; urinary protein excretion was 2.2 g/day with microhaematuria
Physical examination was unremarkable
LVAD infection causing GN
Primary glomerulonephritis
LVAD mechanical renal injury
Blood cultures were positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium
Serum complement C3 was low
Renal biopsy showed mesangial IgM/C1q/C3 deposits without subepithelial humps
Renal biopsy showed focal segmental necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis with crescents
PR3-ANCA was elevated and MPO-ANCA was negative
Corynebacterium jeikeium LVAD infection causing infection-related glomerulonephritis
LVAD infection-related immune-complex glomerulonephritis with crescents
LVAD infection-associated secondary PR3-ANCA glomerulonephritis
FDG-PET/CT shows increased FDG activity at the driveline, pocket, and outflow cannula
Active Corynebacterium jeikeium LVAD infection involving the driveline, pocket, and outflow cannula
Renal biopsy showed subendothelial and mesangial immune-complex deposits
Primary ANCA-associated glomerulonephritis
Immunofluorescence microscopy demonstrated linear IgA deposition along the basement membrane
